plan.name: Strategy 1: Systematic Cabinet Search and Cooling
plan.strategy: Search all cabinets in order, check if a mug is present, cool it if needed, and place it in the first available cabinet.
steps: Search each cabinet sequentially (cabinet 1 to cabinet 6) to locate a mug.
Once a mug is found, check its temperature state.
If the mug is not cool, place it in the fridge to cool it down.
After cooling, return the mug to the same cabinet where it was found or a different cabinet if specified.
